name: post.schedule
description: Sends a post: one job per account, at its slot or now, each sent by post.publish_job at its time. Pressing Schedule is the person's yes to what each job sends, stored with the jobs (an agent's sending leaves them waiting for a person). The post is scheduled, not posted, until each account says so. A retry names the accounts it retries; accounts already live are left alone, and the post's other accounts (planned only, such as TikTok) stay on it.
sql:
with p as (select * from brandbase.posts where id = :id and brand_id = :brand),
b as (select * from brandbase.brands where id = :brand),
w as (select brandbase.send_channels(:id, :channels::jsonb) as chans),
s as (
  select case when :when = 'now' then brandbase.today(:brand, :now::timestamptz) else p.day end as day,
    case when :when = 'now' then to_char(:now::timestamptz at time zone b.timezone, 'HH24:MI') else p.time end as time,
    case when :when = 'now' then :now::timestamptz else brandbase.instant(p.day, p.time, b.timezone) end as run_at
  from p, b
),
keep as (
  select array(select j.channel from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = :id and j.status in ('live', 'scheduled') order by j.status = 'live' desc, j.created_at, j.channel) as chans
),
jobs as (
  insert into brandbase.post_jobs as pj (id, post_id, brand_id, channel, status, run_at)
  select :id || ':' || c, :id, :brand, c, 'scheduled', s.run_at from w, s, unnest(w.chans) c
  on conflict (post_id, channel) do update
    set status = 'scheduled', run_at = excluded.run_at, attempts = 0, error = null, updated_at = now()
    where pj.status in ('scheduled', 'failed')
  returning *
),
sent as (
  update brandbase.posts x set
    channels = array(select c from unnest(keep.chans || w.chans || x.channels) with ordinality t(c, n) group by c order by min(n)),
    day = s.day, time = s.time, marked = null, version = x.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from s, w, keep
  where x.id = :id and x.brand_id = :brand
  returning x.*
)
select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(u), coalesce((
  select jsonb_agg(z.j) from (
    select to_jsonb(n) as j from jobs n
    union all
    select to_jsonb(o) from brandbase.post_jobs o
    where o.post_id = u.id and not exists (select 1 from jobs n where n.id = o.id)
  ) z), '[]')) as result,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'op', 'post.publish_job', 'key', n.id, 'at', brandbase.iso(n.run_at), 'approve', true,
     'input', jsonb_build_object('brand', n.brand_id, 'job', n.id))), '[]')
   from jobs n) as schedule
from sent u
